quote: Policy CORPORAL PUNISHMENT/PHYSICAL FORCE (NEW) Code JKA Issued DRAFT/18 The use of corporal punishment, defined as any act of physical force upon a student for the purpose of punishing that student, is not acceptable in this district and will not be tolerated as a disciplinary measure.
notes: Found by searching for the district's board policy on corporal punishment and read 2026-09-24. `quotes` carries every rule-bearing sentence in document order. Identity is name and state matched against the federal LEA directory; an ambiguous name was not recorded.
